# PromptBill (https://promptbill.online)

> LLM Leaderboard, AI API Pricing Directory, Deals & Credit Offers, Token Counter, and Cost Calculators for November 2026.

## Sections on promptbill.online
- Leaderboard: Model rankings across Frontier, Coding, Reasoning, Agentic, Multimodal, and Open/Local categories.
- API Pricing & Cost: Interactive 30-day API token cost calculator, prompt cache savings, batch discount modeling, and self-host vs. API comparison.
- LLM Selector: Workload-based model recommendations by budget, coding performance, or capability score.
- Token Counter: Live prompt character, word, and estimated token counter with per-model input cost.
- Deals: API credit offers, batch discount strategies, and lifetime Pro access deals.
- Methodology: Transparent scoring, evidence labels, and pricing calculation rules.
- Advertise: Sponsor placements and partnership inquiries.
